title: The Figure a Fresh Verification Starts From on a Vehicle Already Documented
content:
Where a Keyturn Vehicle Listing already carries verified documents, the figure the marketplace starts from on a fresh verification is read off what it already holds for that vehicle.

1. Where a registration has been verified on the vehicle's condition record at any time in the rolling twenty-four months counted back from the handling date, the standard figure is taken as the image count that most recent registration verification carried.

2. Where no registration has been verified in that window but some other document has, the standard figure is taken as the highest image count standing on any verification of that vehicle.

3. Otherwise the marketplace's own standard figure is taken.

### Points of judgement

*Most recent on the first clause, highest on the second.* Where a registration has been verified inside the window, the count taken is the one the most recent such registration verification carried, even where an older registration verification carried more. Where the second clause is reached instead, the count taken is the highest standing on any verification of that vehicle, and that is read across the record as a whole rather than across the twenty-four months alone.

*Which documents open the second clause.* Any verified document of that vehicle other than a registration — a title, a lender consent, an insurance certificate or a recall clearance — opens the second clause, provided it was verified in the rolling twenty-four months counted back from the handling date.

*A vehicle with nothing on file.* Where no document of the vehicle has been verified in the window at all, the third clause governs.
